mutation_policy.notes: GitHub and Cloudflare were used read-only only. No repository or account mutation was performed in the RC8 pass.

coverage: workspace optimistic CAS rejects a stale publisher without replacing a newer head
mission snapshot publishes project version and mission link atomically
backup retention ceiling blocks an unbounded new backup
backup deletion removes D1 reference before bounded R2 cleanup
studio artifact owner deletion removes metadata and backing R2 object
upload preserves R2 when ownership committed but D1 response was lost

secret_pattern_scan.notes: Production source/scripts/UI scan; intentional scanner/example material outside this set was not treated as a credential finding.

not_freshly_verified.npm_ci: Attempted in the isolated environment but dependency installation did not complete within the available execution window; no dependency tree was produced.
not_freshly_verified.semantic_typescript_typecheck: Requires the complete project dependency tree.
not_freshly_verified.full_vitest_suite: Requires the complete project dependency tree.
not_freshly_verified.wrangler_staging_dry_run: Requires Wrangler from the project dependency tree.
not_freshly_verified.wrangler_production_dry_run: Requires Wrangler from the project dependency tree.
not_freshly_verified.staging_migration_smoke: Not executed; no remote mutation was authorized.

release_blockers: Fresh dependency-enabled npm ci/typecheck/full Vitest must pass.
Fresh Wrangler dry-run must pass for staging and production configs.
Disposable staging migration/smoke must pass before any production apply.
Production OIDC issuer/client provenance must be explicitly verified; values are intentionally not guessed.
notes: RC8 intentionally avoids a broad Execution Engine structural refactor until full dependency-backed gates are reproducible.
Historical verification from earlier releases is not used as evidence for RC8.
